campaign_source.campaign_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-resident-mm
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on off; fi
for arm in 16 8 4; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay-$arm"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets" --port 18997 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18997/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 "$root/short-quality.py" http://127.0.0.1:18997 "$arm" "$root/short-quality-$arm.json" > "$root/short-quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18997 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 40 --random-input-len 2048 --random-output-len 256 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done
